name: msva-platform
description: Madhu Sudhan Voice Agent MVP monorepo

scripts.verify: pnpm check:dev-environment && pnpm test:dev-environment && pnpm --filter @msva/shared build && pnpm --filter @msva/contracts build && pnpm --filter @msva/db build && pnpm contracts:check && pnpm test:voice-contracts && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:jev-db && pnpm test:db && pnpm test:voice-db && DATABASE_URL="$MSVA_AUTH_TEST_DATABASE_URL" pnpm test:auth-db && pnpm build
scripts.test:jev-db: node -e "const testUrl=process.env.JEV_TEST_DATABASE_URL; if (!testUrl || !process.env.DATABASE_URL || testUrl !== process.env.DATABASE_URL || !new URL(testUrl).pathname.endsWith('/msva_jev_test')) throw new Error('DATABASE_URL and JEV_TEST_DATABASE_URL must match the disposable msva_jev_test database');" && vitest run --config vitest.jev.config.ts
scripts.test:voice-contracts: cd apps/voice-agent && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --frozen --python 3.12 pytest
scripts.test:db: node -e "if (!process.env.MSVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL) { throw new Error('MSVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL is required for pnpm test:db'); }" && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.test:voice-db: node -e "const testUrl=process.env.MSVA_VOICE_TEST_DATABASE_URL; if (!testUrl || !new URL(testUrl).pathname.endsWith('/msva_voice_test')) throw new Error('MSVA_VOICE_TEST_DATABASE_URL must point at the disposable msva_voice_test database');" && vitest run --config vitest.voice.config.ts
scripts.test:auth-db: node -e "const url=process.env.MSVA_AUTH_TEST_DATABASE_URL; if (!url || !process.env.DATABASE_URL || url !== process.env.DATABASE_URL || !new URL(url).pathname.endsWith('/msva_auth_test')) throw new Error('DATABASE_URL and MSVA_AUTH_TEST_DATABASE_URL must match disposable msva_auth_test');" && vitest run --config vitest.auth.config.ts
